map.输入双方当前 Elo 等级分与对局结果，估算本局后的等级分变化，帮助棋手判断胜负: Enter both players' current Elo ratings and game result; estimate the post-game rating change, helping players judge ranking impact and strength gap.
map.单局分数变化：由 R_A、R_B 与胜负（胜/负/和）算 ΔE 与更新后分数。: Single-game score change: from R_A, R_B and outcome (win/loss/draw) compute ΔE and updated score.
map.预期胜率：由分差算 P_A=1/(1+10^((R_B−R_A)/400))，预: Expected win rate: from rating gap, P_A = 1/(1+10^((R_B-R_A)/400)), predicts game tendency.
map.多局连算：连续多局累计分数变化，模拟一段赛程的升降轨迹。: Multi-game consecutive: accumulate score changes over consecutive games, simulate a rating trajectory over a stretch.
map.：输入 R_A=1500、R_B=1600、结果胜、K=32，工具输出预期胜率约: : Input R_A=1500, R_B=1600, result win, K=32; the tool outputs expected win rate ≈ 36.4%, ΔE ≈ +22.7, new score ≈ 1522.7, and notes the underdog scores more on upset.
map.新选手取大 K（如 40）快速收敛，成熟选手取小 K（10/20）；许多平台默认: New players use large K (e.g., 40) for fast convergence, mature players small K (10/20); many platforms default 32. Larger K means bigger single-game swings.
map.P=1/(1+10^(−ΔR/400))，分差 400 约对应胜率 0.91，0: P = 1/(1+10^(-ΔR/400)); a 400-point gap corresponds to about 0.91 win rate; 0-point gap gives 0.5 each.
map.长期趋近真实水平；胜负平衡时分稳定，连胜/连败会随分差自动减速。: Long term converges to true level; stable at balanced wins/losses; win/loss streaks auto-decelerate with the rating gap.
